purpose: Personal research: evaluate a causal feature group without claiming trading profitability

source.selection_limitation: Two preselected surviving large US technology companies; no market-wide inference

forecast_origin: after the preceding session close is available
estimator: training-only StandardScaler followed by Ridge with deterministic SVD solver
hypothesis: Absolute return lags may add magnitude-dependent mean-return information beyond signed return lags; the effect may be absent or unstable

feature_definitions.returns: Last L observed log returns, newest first
feature_definitions.returns_abs: Signed return lags followed by their absolute values; L additional causal features

development.partial_final_fold: not scored; report unused tail explicitly
development.selection: Each feature group tunes lookback and alpha on the same inner validation targets; pooled outer-development RMSE selects the group per asset
development.tie_policy: Prefer returns when aggregate RMSE is equal within 1e-12

final_fit_policy: Freeze the selected feature group; tune lookback/alpha on the last 126 pre-holdout observations using earlier training only; no refit; score final holdout once
randomness: Deterministic Ridge SVD; seed 42 recorded, no stochastic training or seed cherry-picking
tuning_budget: 6 trials per feature group per development fold; 6 final trials for the selected group
reporting: Retain every fold/group/trial, failures, negative results, raw predictions and input/artifact hashes; never retune based on final holdout
promotion: No automatic model promotion; pipeline validity does not require beating the baseline
